questions.question: 12 is related to 66 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 24 is related to 276. To which of the following is 10 related, following the same logic?
questions.questionHtml: 12 is related to 66 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 24 is related to 276. To which of the following is 10 related, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
Related number = (Number × half of the number) − half of the number

That is,

Related number = n × (n/2) − (n/2)

Now check:

For 12:
12 × 6 − 6 = 72 − 6 = 66

For 24:
24 × 12 − 12 = 288 − 12 = 276

Now for 10:
10 × 5 − 5 = 50 − 5 = 45

Answer: (d) 45

(19, 24, 7)
(12, 14, 5)
questions.solution:
Answer: (d) (3, 4, 1)

Solution:

• The pattern is: second number = 2 × (first number − third number).

• Check the given sets:

2 × (19 − 7) = 2 × 12 = 24

2 × (12 − 5) = 2 × 7 = 14

• Now check option (d):

2 × (3 − 1) = 2 × 2 = 4

So, (3, 4, 1) follows the same pattern.
